name: Spirit Spring
uniques: Guaranteed with Strategic Balance resource option

civilopediaText.text: A spring of heaven-and-earth energy (灵泉) that yields primeval stones. Every Qing Mao clan built its village on one; whoever loses its spring loses its future.

name: Moon Orchid
uniques: Guaranteed with Strategic Balance resource option

civilopediaText.text: Moon orchids (月兰花), whose petals feed the Moonlight Gu. A Moon clan without them has blades that will not cut.

name: Wild Boar
uniques: Guaranteed with Strategic Balance resource option

civilopediaText.text: Wild boars (野猪) of the Qing Mao forests: pork for the boar Gu, tusks for the refiner. Strength clans count them like stones.

name: Jade
uniques: Guaranteed with Strategic Balance resource option

civilopediaText.text: Fine jade (玉石), the food of the jade-skin Gu and the price of every rank-two fusion. Both paths need it, so both paths fight for it.
Brewed wine (酒), drunk by villagers and by the Liquor Worm. Brewed in taverns, never found in the wild.
A dead Gu Master's inheritance (传承), unearthed and held: recipes, materials, insight. Whoever holds the ground holds the prize, so nobody holds it for long without a fight.
Pelts of Southern Border beasts, sold by caravans. The only comfort the mountain offers for free, once someone has killed for it.
Heaven qi (天气) falls on the land a clan holds: 1 a turn for every 15 land tiles.
Earth qi (地气) rises from spring caves and hills: 1 a turn per spring cave and per 8 hills.
Human qi (人气) is gathered through people and deeds: 1 a turn per 10 citizens, and 5% of the damage your units deal.
Rank-six immortal essence (青提仙元). It never refills by itself: blessed lands make it, and a few immortal Gu, inheritances and trades.

Lifespan Gu (寿蛊) are made only by heaven and earth where life teems; nobody can refine one. Forests, jungles and swamps yield a few, as do some immortal Gu and inheritances. Reaching rank six, seven, eight and nine brings 20, 25, 35 and 60, and a higher rank burns them more slowly: one each 10, 15, 20 or 30 turns on Standard. With none left an immortal heals only by pillaging and wastes away (7 HP a turn). Civilopedia, Tutorials: Immortal Lifespan.

Ranked materials (仙材) from which immortal Gu are refined: 15 for a rank-six Gu up to 40 for rank nine, 30 for a Gu House. Blessed lands grow 1-2 a turn, a grotto-heaven 3; a slain desolate beast yields 20; Treasure Yellow Heaven buys a surplus for essence.
Rank-seven immortal essence (红枣仙元). Blessed lands of rank-seven immortals make it; rank-seven immortal Gu cost it.
Rank-eight immortal essence (白荔仙元), made by grotto-heavens; rank-eight immortal Gu cost it.
Rank-nine essence (黄杏仙元); even a Venerable runs short of it. Only a living Venerable makes it; Eternal Life costs 300 on Standard.
